what: 50 cm: repeat of the band comparison, then a live-voice check with the 50 cm model

band_repeat.verdict: Only the 400 Hz band reproduces in direction and magnitude (canceller lowers the closed-loop level by 3.0-3.6 dB in two independent runs). The other bands flip sign between runs, so nothing is claimed for them.

voice_check_50cm.result: the voice capture tripped input full scale (capture_status bit22) immediately
voice_check_50cm.reading: At 50 cm with the working gain of -8 dB the microphone reaches the ADC rail during live speech, so the input has no headroom at this distance and gain. This is an operating-point limit, not a canceller failure.

what_this_means: A 50 cm improvement is demonstrable in the 400 Hz band with a geometry-matched model, in two runs.
A 50 cm LIVE working point at -8 dB is not usable: live speech saturates the input.
Lowering the gain would very likely make 50 cm usable, but the captain forbade changing the working gain in this round, so it was not tried.
not_claimed: no claim at gains other than -8 dB
